anchor.statement: Corollary B.10. The analytic axis profile of Proposition B.2 admits a smooth continuation with E > 0 for X > 0, matching the reference outer radial profile at log(X/X R ) = −5, with exact fields, pressure, and radial moment functions. It has vanishing leading residual stress through X 0 , followed by an inner collar on which the profile remains analytic in η and satisfies the admissible stress cone condition, with the flat factor (B.30). It satisfies the strict inequalities of the relaxed cone condition thereafter up to the matching point. Its finite parameters can be chosen in the order (B.40).

correspondence.by: Christian Garry (drafted with Claude Code; second review by ChatGPT, checked)
correspondence.note: exists_certificate gives a nominal witness with the relaxed cone on the active interval, the admissible cone on an initial collar and on the outgoing range; heat_agreement and moments_after give exact outer fields, pressure and moments. nominal_ACT_fields and nominal_activation_stress state that, on the collar, the witness's fields and stress equal the activation (ACT) fields and stress, for which analyticity in η and the flat factor (B.30) are stated (Corollary B.6). Carrying analyticity, the flat factor and zero stress through X0 over to this profile through those identities is the reviewer's assembly.
